items.title: 24.6.2 Electrophoresis se amino acids alag karna (Roman Urdu)

blocks.text: Electrophoresis mixture ke amino acids ko un ke charge se alag karta hai. Mixture ke chand qatre do electrodes ke darmiyan buffered mehlool mein rakhe filter paper ya gel par dale jate hain. Electric field lagane par amino acids apni pI qeematon ke mutabiq alag hote hain. Agar amino acid ka pI mehlool ke pH se zyada ho to yeh zyada tar musbat shakal mein hota aur cathode ki taraf jata hai; agar pI pH se kam ho to zyada tar manfi aur anode ki taraf jata hai. pI aur pH ka farq jitna zyada, raftaar utni tez. Agar do amino acids ki pI qeematein bohat qareeb hon (jaise glycine aur leucine), to zyada molecular mass wala aahista chalta hai, kyunke charge ko zyada wazan uthana parta hai.

blocks.alt: Peeli patti, baen manfi electrode aur daen musbat electrode, teen dhabbe: Lysine (pI = 9.74) manfi sire ke qareeb, Alanine (pI = 6.02) beech mein aur Glutamic acid (pI = 3.22) musbat sire ke qareeb, har aik ke label se teer.
blocks.caption: Figure 24.2: pH 6 par electrophoresis se amino acids ki alahdagi (kitab ki Figure 24.2 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: pH 6 par: lysine ka pI (9.74) pH se zyada hai, is liye woh musbat hai aur manfi electrode (cathode, baen) ki taraf jata hai. Alanine ka pI (6.02) pH ke qareeb hai, is liye woh taqreeban beech mein rehta hai. Glutamic acid ka pI (3.22) pH se kam hai, is liye woh manfi hai aur musbat electrode (anode, daen) ki taraf jata hai.

Amino acids be-rang hain, is liye dhabbe dhoondne parte hain. Ninhydrin pehchan karane wale agent ke taur par use hota hai: yeh amino acids se react kar ke jamni product deta hai. Electrophoresis amino acids ki bari miqdar alag nahi kar sakta; yeh jaanchne ka tareeqa hai ke mixture mein kitne amino acids hain. Poore mixture ko waqai alag karne ke liye column chromatography jaise doosre tareeqe use hote hain.

blocks.alt: Do satron mein: amino acid (NH2 wale carbon par R aur COOH) + 2 ninhydrin (benzene ring paanch-kona ring se juri, do C=O aur beech ke carbon par do OH), teer ke oopar NaOH, se jamni product (aisi do ring ikaiyan C-N=C se juri, har aik mein do C=O) + zimni maadde H2O, CO2 aur RCHO.
blocks.caption: Amino acid ka ninhydrin se reaction (kitab ke PDF safha 131 ki be-number figure ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Ninhydrin ke do molecules aik amino acid se react karte hain. Amino acid ka nitrogen do ninhydrin hisson ko jor deta hai aur jamni (purple) product banta hai; amino acid ka baqi hissa CO2 aur aldehyde (RCHO) ban kar alag ho jata hai, aur paani bhi nikalta hai. Isi jamni rang se paper par be-rang amino acids ke dhabbe nazar aate hain.

blocks.prompt: pH 6 par lysine (pI 9.74) kis electrode ki taraf jata hai, aur kyun?
blocks.explanation: Cathode (manfi electrode) ki taraf: is ka pI pH se zyada hai, is liye is par kul musbat charge hai.

items: pI > pH: musbat, cathode ki taraf; pI < pH: manfi, anode ki taraf.
Ninhydrin be-rang dhabbon ko jamni dikhata.
